entry.title: Crater Lake Snowpack Falls Into Record-Low Territory, NWS Says
entry.summary: Crater Lake-area snowpack has fallen into record-low territory, according to the National Weather Service. Annie Springs SWE was at just 22% of its normal April peak on March 28, while snow depth at Crater Lake measured 17 inches, far below the 118-inch normal.
